Story B involves social interaction and direct engagement; the protagonist speaks with refugees (S005-C01), intervenes to save children from monsters (S009-C01, S010-C01), and fights to defend a Prince (S014-C01), leading to a different narrative arc involving a royal message before dying in a separate ambush. The manner of acting—solitary evasion versus communal defense—creates a clear distinction in the adventure experience.
